name: data
description:
Read a page of data from a table in the project's Convex deployment.

Output:
- page: A page of results from the table.
- isDone: Whether there are more results to read.
- continueCursor: The cursor to use to read the next page of results.

deploymentSelector.description: Deployment selector (from the status tool) to read data from.

tableName.description: The name of the table to read from.

order.description: The order to sort the results in.

cursor.description: The cursor to start reading from.

limit.description: The maximum number of results to return, defaults to 100.

name: tables
description: List all tables in a particular Convex deployment and their inferred and declared schema.

deploymentSelector.description: Deployment selector (from the status tool) to read tables from.

name: functionSpec
description:
Get the function metadata from a Convex deployment.

Returns an array of structured objects for each function the deployment. Each function's
metadata contains its identifier (which is its path within the convex/ folder joined
with its exported name), its argument validator, its return value validator, its type
(i.e. is it a query, mutation, or action), and its visibility (i.e. is it public or
internal).

deploymentSelector.description: Deployment selector (from the status tool) to get function metadata from.

name: run
description:
Run a Convex function (query, mutation, or action) on your deployment.

Returns the result and any log lines generated by the function.

deploymentSelector.description: Deployment selector (from the status tool) to run the function on.

functionName.description: The name of the function to run (e.g. 'path/to/my/module.js:myFunction').

args.description: The argument object to pass to the function, JSON-encoded as a string.

name: envList
description: List all environment variables in your Convex deployment.

deploymentSelector.description: Deployment selector (from the status tool) to list environment variables from.

name: envGet
description: Get a specific environment variable from your Convex deployment.

deploymentSelector.description: Deployment selector (from the status tool) to get environment variable from.

name.description: The name of the environment variable to retrieve.

name: envSet
description: Set an environment variable in your Convex deployment.

deploymentSelector.description: Deployment selector (from the status tool) to set environment variable on.

name.description: The name of the environment variable to set.

value.description: The value to set for the environment variable.

name: envRemove
description: Remove an environment variable from your Convex deployment.

deploymentSelector.description: Deployment selector (from the status tool) to remove environment variable from.

name.description: The name of the environment variable to remove.

name: runOneoffQuery

deploymentSelector.description: Deployment selector (from the status tool) to run the query on.

query.description: JavaScript module source for a single file (testQuery.js) that exports a default readonly query, for example: export default query({ handler: async (ctx) => ({ count: (await ctx.db.query("messages").take(10)).length }) });

name: logs
description:
Fetch a chunk of recent log entries from your Convex deployment.

Returns a batch of UDF execution log entries and a new cursor you can use to
request the next batch. This tool does not tail; it performs a single fetch.

To see only errors and exceptions, set status to "failure". This filters to
executions where a function threw an error, which is useful for debugging
deployment issues. Each failed entry includes the error message and stack trace.

deploymentSelector.description: Deployment selector (from the status tool) to read logs from.

status.description: Filter by execution outcome. "failure" returns only executions that threw an error. "success" returns only successful executions. Defaults to "all".

cursor.description: Optional cursor (in ms) to start reading from. Use 0 to read from the beginning.

entriesLimit.description: Maximum number of log entries to return (from the end). If omitted, returns all available in this chunk.

tokensLimit.description: Approximate maximum number of tokens to return (applied to the JSON payload). Defaults to 20000.

jsonl.description: If true, return raw log entries as JSONL. If false (default), return formatted text logs.
